children: Kuwait’s Central Agency for Public Tenders (CAPT) has scheduled a negotiation session on 28 September with the two parties that passed the technical evaluation for the contract to operate and manage the new Terminal 2 (T2) at Kuwait International Airport, local Arabic language newspaper Al Rai reported on Sunday.

The negotiations are with a Turkish consortium comprising TAV Airports Holding and Limak Construction, and South Korea’s Incheon International Airport Corporation, as the authorities move towards selecting an operator for the new terminal.
The contract covers the operation and management of T2 and its aircraft aprons, as well as maintenance, development and improvement of training services.
The date of the negotiation session was included in the meeting minutes published in the official gazette, Kuwait Al-Youm, the report added
(Writing by Majda Muhsen; Editing by Anoop Menon)

title: Kuwait sets September 28 talks with shortlisted companies for airport Terminal 2 operations
